topics.title: SD-WAN components: vManage, vSmart, vBond and WAN Edge (vEdge, cEdge)
paraphrases: The roles of the SD-WAN manager, controller, orchestrator and edge routers and how they divide management, control and data planes.

concepts.learning_objective: The roles of the SD-WAN manager, controller, orchestrator and edge routers and how they divide management, control and data planes.

topics.title: TLOCs and transport colors
paraphrases: How a transport location is identified by system IP, color and encapsulation, the standard colors and how the restrict option changes tunnel formation.

concepts.learning_objective: How a transport location is identified by system IP, color and encapsulation, the standard colors and how the restrict option changes tunnel formation.

topics.title: OMP (Overlay Management Protocol) routes and attributes
paraphrases: How OMP distributes routes, TLOCs and service routes between edges and controllers, its attributes, graceful restart and the commands to view it.

concepts.learning_objective: How OMP distributes routes, TLOCs and service routes between edges and controllers, its attributes, graceful restart and the commands to view it.

topics.title: SD-WAN device authentication and data plane encryption
paraphrases: How SD-WAN devices authenticate each other with certificates and how data plane traffic is protected with IPsec.

concepts.learning_objective: How SD-WAN devices authenticate each other with certificates and how data plane traffic is protected with IPsec.

topics.title: BFD tunnel liveness and path monitoring in SD-WAN
paraphrases: How BFD runs over every SD-WAN tunnel to detect failures and measure path quality, and what happens when a session fails.

concepts.learning_objective: How BFD runs over every SD-WAN tunnel to detect failures and measure path quality, and what happens when a session fails.

topics.title: Centralized control policies and overlay topologies (hub-and-spoke, mesh)

concepts.learning_objective: Using vSmart control policies to shape route and TLOC advertisement and build hub-and-spoke, mesh or partial-mesh topologies.

topics.title: Application-aware routing (AAR) and SLA classes

concepts.learning_objective: How application-aware routing picks tunnels per application using real-time loss, latency and jitter measured against SLA classes.

topics.title: Service chaining and service insertion
paraphrases: Steering traffic through services such as firewalls or WAN optimizers placed in the path using policy and service routes.

topics.title: SD-WAN QoS policy and DSCP marking
paraphrases: Classifying, marking and prioritizing traffic with DSCP and QoS policies on SD-WAN edges.

concepts.learning_objective: Classifying, marking and prioritizing traffic with DSCP and QoS policies on SD-WAN edges.

topics.title: Embedded security: zone-based firewall, IPS (Snort) and URL filtering
paraphrases: The on-box security features of SD-WAN edges, including the enterprise firewall, Snort-based IPS and URL filtering.
